mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TEAMS t USING (SELECT #{teamId} AS TEAM_ID FROM DUAL) s ON (t.TEAM_ID = s.TEAM_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.TEAM_NAME = #{teamName}, t.EMBLEM_URL = NVL(#{emblemUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, t.EMBLEM_URL), t.HOME_GROUND = NVL(t.HOME_GROUND, NVL(#{homeGround, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '홈 경기장')), t.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (TEAM_ID, TEAM_NAME, HISTORY, EMBLEM_URL, ANTHEM_URL, FOUNDED_YEAR, HOME_GROUND, UPDATED_AT) VALUES ( #{teamId}, #{teamName}, #{history, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{emblemUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{anthemUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CASE WHEN #{foundedYear, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NOT NULL THEN TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(#{foundedYear, jdbcType=NUMERIC}), 'YYYY') ELSE TO_DATE('1900', 'YYYY') END, NVL(#{homeGround, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '홈 경기장'), SYSTIMESTAMP )

MERGE INTO PLAYERS p USING (SELECT #{playerId} AS PLAYER_ID FROM DUAL) s ON (p.PLAYER_ID = s.PLAYER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET p.NAME = #{name}, p.BACK_NUMBER = #{backNumber, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, p.MAIN_POSITION = #{mainPosition}, p.NATIONALITY = #{nationality, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, p.TEAM_ID = #{teamId} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PLAYER_ID, NAME, BACK_NUMBER, MAIN_POSITION, NATIONALITY, TEAM_ID) VALUES ( #{playerId}, #{name}, #{backNumber, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{mainPosition}, #{nationality, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{teamId} )

MERGE INTO PLAYER_STATS ps USING (SELECT #{playerId} AS PLAYER_ID FROM DUAL) s ON (ps.PLAYER_ID = s.PLAYER_ID) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PLAYER_ID, GOALS, ASSISTS, MOM_COUNT, YELLOW_CARDS, RED_CARDS, IS_INJURED, IS_SUSPENDED) VALUES (#{playerId}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 'N', 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT PLAYER_ID, NAME, BACK_NUMBER, MAIN_POSITION, NATIONALITY, TEAM_ID FROM PLAYERS WHERE TEAM_ID = #{teamId} ORDER BY CASE MAIN_POSITION WHEN 'GK' THEN 1 WHEN 'DF' THEN 2 WHEN 'MF' THEN 3 WHEN 'FW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, BACK_NUMBER ASC NULLS LAST, NAME ASC
SELECT TEAM_ID, TEAM_NAME, HISTORY, EMBLEM_URL, ANTHEM_URL, TO_CHAR(FOUNDED_YEAR, 'YYYY') AS FOUNDED_YEAR, HOME_GROUND, UPDATED_AT FROM TEAMS WHERE TEAM_ID = #{teamId}
SELECT TEAM_ID, TEAM_NAME, HISTORY, EMBLEM_URL, ANTHEM_URL, TO_CHAR(FOUNDED_YEAR, 'YYYY') AS FOUNDED_YEAR, HOME_GROUND, UPDATED_AT FROM TEAMS ORDER BY TEAM_NAME ASC
